scripts.build: test -f ./venv/bin/python3 && ./venv/bin/python3 -c 'import py_compile, glob; [py_compile.compile(f) for f in ["app.py", "run_app.py"] + glob.glob("src/*.py")]' || python3 -c 'import py_compile, glob; [py_compile.compile(f) for f in ["app.py", "run_app.py"] + glob.glob("src/*.py")]'
scripts.lint: test -f ./venv/bin/python3 && ./venv/bin/python3 -m py_compile app.py run_app.py src/*.py || python3 -m py_compile app.py run_app.py src/*.py
